replies.author: Key-Soft-8248
replies.body:
Thanks ! I prompted  in french, here is the translation : " Add a short cinematic introduction at the beginning of the game.

- Fade in cinematic black bars at the top and bottom of the screen.
- Play a slow, low-altitude semi-aerial camera flyby around the starting island.
- During the flyby, show our character naturally walking back and forth between his airplane and the restaurant, as if going through his daily routine.
- Display subtitles explaining the backstory.

Suggested text:

«"After retiring from the Air Force, our old pilot settled down on a peaceful island and opened a small restaurant. But a few months ago, dragons started attacking the nearby islands. Never one to sit around while others are in danger, the old veteran dusted off his trusty old plane and took to the skies once again. Now he hunts dragons to protect the region... and, if we're being honest, dragon meat makes for some pretty incredible cooking."»

Also create a small animated 3D portrait of the main character.

- Display it inside a square UI panel that matches the visual style of the rest of the interface.
- Give the portrait subtle idle animations (head movement, blinking, slight mouth movement while speaking).
- Throughout the game, have him occasionally comment on what is happening with short voiced or text speech bubbles.
- His personality should be that of an old-school Air Force veteran: experienced, sarcastic, a little grumpy, but ultimately likeable. His dialogue should be lighthearted and slightly comedic to give the game more personality and immersion.

Examples:

- "Heh... reminds me of the old days."
- "That's one big lizard..."
- "Hope you're hungry, little buddy."
- "I've flown through worse."
- "Dragons... they don't build 'em like they used to."
- "Dinner's going to be interesting tonight."

After the intro, smoothly transition into normal gameplay.

The cinematic should last between 30 seconds and 1 minute, and there should always be a Skip button so players can jump straight into the game if they want. " 

Nothing special I believe 😅
